title: LoASR-Bench: Evaluating Large Speech Language Models on Low-Resource Automatic Speech Recognition Across Language Famili

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: What if AI could understand speech in any language — even rare ones?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: LLMs are changing speech tech, but low-resource languages are still left behind.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: LoASR-Bench tests how well SpeechLMs work for languages with little data.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It uses 12 low-resource languages, showing big gaps in current models.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This impacts millions who speak underrepresented languages globally.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key takeaway? Speech AI still struggles where data is scarce.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Have you ever tried using voice tech in your language and it failed?
